context_policy.rule: V7 is the sole PAPER champion designation and the only destination. The designation does not imply that main, paper-validated, private deployment or Grafana have already converged. Do not restore V3-V6 for compatibility. Port only required primitives into V7/common/control-plane and complete exact-SHA PAPER validation, main, paper-validated, deploy and server-health before final legacy deletion.

grafana.rule: The V7 PAPER champion is designated but not yet operationally deployed. Champion-specific Grafana becomes canonical only after exact-SHA paper-validated deployment and server-health verification.

security.rule: SSH private keys and other credentials must remain outside version control.
